steps.title: The 2018 Todo app
steps.text: This Todo app is built the way many React apps were in 2018: class components, Redux with hand-written actions, Redux-Saga for the import, and an Immutable.js `Map` as the state. It starts with one todo, **Use Redux**. The next steps add, tick, filter, import, open **About** and go back. The guide for today's version takes the same steps, so you can compare what happens underneath.
steps.textZh: 这个 Todo 应用按 2018 年许多 React 应用的方式搭建：class 组件，手写 action 的 Redux，负责导入的 Redux-Saga，再用一个 Immutable.js 的 `Map` 作为状态。列表一开始只有一条待办：**使用 Redux**。接下来的几步依次新增、勾选、筛选、导入、打开**关于**，再后退。今天风格版本的说明走的是同样的步骤，方便对照两边底下发生了什么。

steps.title: Add a todo
steps.text: What you type stays in the component's own `state`, not in the store. **Add** calls `this.props.actions.addTodo(text)`. `bindActionCreators` wrapped each action creator made by `createAction`, so calling one dispatches an action, here `{ type: 'TODO/ADD', payload: { text } }`. The reducer's `TODO/ADD` case returns a new Immutable `Map` with one more todo, and `connect` renders the page again. The field is empty again because `submit` calls `setState({ text: '' })`.
steps.textZh: 输入的文字保存在组件自己的 `state` 里，不进 store。**新增**调用 `this.props.actions.addTodo(text)`。`bindActionCreators` 把 `createAction` 生成的每个 action creator 包了一层，调用它就会派发一个 action，这里是 `{ type: 'TODO/ADD', payload: { text } }`。reducer 的 `TODO/ADD` 分支返回一个多了一条待办的新 Immutable `Map`，`connect` 随之重新渲染页面。输入框又空了，因为 `submit` 调用了 `setState({ text: '' })`。
steps.actionLabel: Type “Read the source” and click Add
steps.actionLabelZh: 输入“读一读源码”，再点「新增」

steps.title: Tick it, then filter
steps.text: Ticking dispatches `TODO/COMPLETE`, and its reducer case flips `completed` in a new `List`. **Active** dispatches `TODO/FILTER`, which only stores the filter's name next to the todos. Each time the store changes, `connect` calls `visibleTodos` from `reducer.js`, and it picks the todos for that filter. **Read the source** leaves the screen, but it is still in the store.
steps.textZh: 勾选会派发 `TODO/COMPLETE`，reducer 的这个分支在一个新的 `List` 里把 `completed` 取反。**未完成**派发 `TODO/FILTER`，它只是把筛选条件的名字存在待办旁边。store 每次变化，`connect` 都会调用 `reducer.js` 里的 `visibleTodos`，由它挑出符合条件的待办。**读一读源码**从屏幕上消失了，但它仍在 store 里。
steps.actionLabel: Tick “Read the source”, then click Active
steps.actionLabelZh: 勾选“读一读源码”，再点「未完成」

steps.title: Import two examples
steps.text: This step shows **All** again, then clicks **Import examples**, which dispatches `TODO/IMPORT`. The saga in `sagas.js` answers it one step at a time. With `put` it sends `TODO/IMPORT_START`, which sets the status to `Loading`. With `call` it runs `fetchTodos`, which reads `todos.json`. Then it sends `TODO/BATCH_ADD` with the two titles, or `TODO/IMPORT_ERROR` if reading failed. `takeLeading` ignores more clicks while an import is running. Loading, success and failure are three reducer cases written by hand.
steps.textZh: 这一步先切回**全部**，再点击**导入示例**，它会派发 `TODO/IMPORT`。`sagas.js` 里的 saga 一步一步地响应：先用 `put` 发出 `TODO/IMPORT_START`，把状态设为 `Loading`；再用 `call` 调用 `fetchTodos`，读取 `todos.json`；最后用 `put` 发出带着两条标题的 `TODO/BATCH_ADD`，读取失败时则是 `TODO/IMPORT_ERROR`。导入进行期间，`takeLeading` 会忽略新的点击。加载中、成功和失败，是 reducer 里手写的三个分支。
steps.actionLabel: Show All, then click Import examples
steps.actionLabelZh: 切回「全部」，再点「导入示例」

steps.title: Open About
steps.text: The router is react-router-dom's `HashRouter`. Its `Link` changes the address with `history.pushState`, as the handwritten router in this repository does, and keeps the page name after `#`, so the address now ends in `#/about`. Any static server can serve that, because the part after `#` is never sent to the server. The Todo page is gone from the screen, but the store still holds the todos.
steps.textZh: 路由是 react-router-dom 的 `HashRouter`。它的 `Link` 和本仓库里手写的路由一样，用 `history.pushState` 修改地址，并把页面名放在 `#` 后面，所以地址现在以 `#/about` 结尾。任何静态服务器都能提供这样的地址，因为 `#` 后面的部分从来不会发给服务器。Todo 页面从屏幕上消失了，但 store 里仍然保存着这些待办。

steps.title: Go back
steps.text: The browser fires `popstate`, and the router shows the Todo page again. All four todos are there, because they live in the store. `Imported 2 todos` is still there too: in this version the status is part of the store, written by the `TODO/BATCH_ADD` case. The browser's own Back and Forward buttons work the same way.
steps.textZh: 浏览器触发 `popstate`，路由重新显示 Todo 页面。四条待办都还在，因为它们保存在 store 里。「已导入 2 条待办」也还在：在这个版本里，状态消息同样是 store 的一部分，由 `TODO/BATCH_ADD` 分支写入。浏览器自己的后退、前进按钮也是同样的效果。
